projectDescription: The single web platform where CGIAR Initiatives, Centers, and partners plan, capture, qualify, and submit reportable results for the OneCGIAR portfolio.
keyFeatures: Typed result capture for all CGIAR result types (knowledge products, capacity sharing, innovation development/use, IPSR, policy change)
Structured submission workflow: Editing → Quality Assessed → Submitted
Quality Assurance tooling with review queues, structured comments, and status transitions
Innovation Package (IPSR) pathway authoring with multi-step workflows
CLARISA integration for master data (centers, initiatives, partners, countries, indicators) with scheduled syncs
Theory of Change alignment — attach results to ToC outcomes
Bilateral and platform-report typed payload surfaces for downstream consumers
Phase/version management (reporting year + sub-phases) with snapshot-on-rollover semantics
Role-based access control with Admin, Lead, Co-Lead, Coordinator, Member, and Guest roles
Real-time notifications via Pusher + WebSockets and transactional email
Admin tooling for roles, AD users, global parameters, phases, soft-delete recovery, and narratives
publicApiSurface: GET /api/bilateral/* — JWT-excluded typed payload surfaces per result type
GET /api/results — List and filter PRMS results
GET /api/result-qaed/* — Quality assurance decisions and transitions
GET /api/home/* — Landing-page aggregates and dashboard data
GET /clarisa/* — CLARISA catalog proxy (centers, initiatives, countries, regions, indicators)
GET /toc/* — Theory of Change trees and result→ToC mappings
